verdict.rationale: Relay's docs claim invoicing with automated payment follow-up ('let Relay handle the follow-up') and payment collection built into invoices, directly supporting automated overdue-invoice chasing. However, this is only first-party marketing copy with no independent or hands-on confirmation of how the follow-up automation actually works (frequency, customization, escalation rules). Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the follow-up feature, detail on automation rules/customization, and evidence of reliability in practice.
